name: Eveready East Africa Plc
source: Eveready East Africa Plc audited results for the financial year ended 30 September 2021, group column, filed with the NSE | NSEBLOCKED 17 Nov 2026: no audited accounts have been published since the year ended 30 September 2023, whose annual report was released on 3 June 2024. The document register at africanfinancials.com (company ke-evrd) ends with the unaudited half year to 31 March 2024 released 1 October 2024, and that filing carries interim figures only; the NSE copy of it is at https://nse.co.ke/wp-content/uploads/Eveready-East-Africa-Plc-Un-audited-Results-for-the-Six-Months-Period-Ended-31-Mar-2024.pdf. Audited FY2024 and FY2025 statements are not obtainable from any reachable source.
source_note: Group column of the audited statement of cash flows for the year ended 30 September 2021 with the 30 September 2020 comparative, KES thousands. Operating plus investing plus financing reproduces the printed net decrease in cash and cash equivalents in both years. The filing printed no equipment purchase in FY2021, so that year carries the printed nil capital expenditure.

filerStatus.source: Nairobi Securities Exchange, 2025 Combined Corporate Calendar, section 2025 Corporate Calendars not Submitted
filerStatus.note: The exchange lists the issuer among companies that did not submit its 2025 corporate calendar. AfricanFinancials holds only a 2024 interim report and the 2023 annual report for this issuer, and the market data providers still carry FY2023 as the latest full year, so no FY2024 or FY2025 audited statement is available.
filerStatus.reasonShort: no audited annual statement after FY2023 has been published.
